verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents broad programmatic access. The SQL API can run queries and manage the deployment, including provisioning users and roles and creating tables. A separate REST API for resource management ships with official OpenAPI specs and Postman collections, and there is an official CLI covering app workloads plus a managed MCP server. However, no evidence states that UI and API are at parity, and UI features such as Snowsight Notebooks and the Query History page have no documented API equivalents in this pack. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API coverage of Snowsight-only features (Notebooks, Query History/query profile UI), independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
